{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99):", qa_mask.sum())

# Check if any QA orders are in the 'loyal' segment
qa_loyal = sales[qa_mask & (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')]
print("Number of QA orders among loyal customers:", len(qa_loyal))

# Print the first few QA orders
print("First 5 QA orders (loyal):", qa_loyal.head())"}
